build_bert_config: build a BertConfig object from a JSON file or vocabulary size with custom hyperparameters
create_bert_model: create a BertModel with embeddings, encoder layers, and optional pooler for sequence encoding
build_bert_for_pretraining: build a BertForPreTraining model with masked language modeling and pair target prediction heads
register_bert_pair_model: register a bert_pair Fairseq model with configurable base or large architecture variants
run_pretraining_forward: run a forward pass on BertForPreTraining to get masked LM, NSP, and pair target prediction scores
